scope: Admission-average and certificate-conversion rules for AAUP bachelor, intermediate diploma, and upper-basic education diploma applicants.
sourcePriority: Attached 2026/2027 PDF and DOC admission materials

notes: Some programs use branch-specific minimums or an alternative core-subject average.
The current official website overrides older values in the attached PDFs where the sources differ.

preparatoryPathForLiteraryClassification.result: Scientific classification after the required preparatory courses are passed.
preparatoryPathForLiteraryClassification.exception: This preparatory reclassification route does not apply to Faculty of Dentistry programs.

scientificUnitSubjectsListedByAAUP: Electronic and Electrical Systems in Vehicles
Foundations of Information and Communication Technologies

scientificClassification.reviewNote: AAUP may review additional scientific units not included in the published list.

requiredDocuments: Stress-test report for Sport Sciences applicants

IB.averageFormula: Sum of converted course percentages divided by number of courses.
additionalPoints: Add the points recorded for Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK).
For extra Higher Level courses: add 2 percentage points for a grade of 6 or 7, or 1 point for a grade of 5.
IB.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

IGCSE_GCSE_GCE.courseSelection: Use the highest two Advanced or Advanced Subsidiary courses and the highest six Ordinary Level courses.

scientificClassificationWhenEquivalencyH.additionalRequirement: Mathematics must be included among the Ordinary Level courses.

IGCSE_GCSE_GCE.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

SAT.averageFormula: Average the converted SAT II subjects listed in the Ministry equivalency; if subjects are not listed, AAUP decides case by case.
SAT.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

AP.averageFormula: Sum of converted subject percentages divided by number of subjects.
AP.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

CLEP.averageFormula: Sum of converted subject percentages divided by number of subjects.
CLEP.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

SaudiSecondaryCertificate.decisionMode: AAUP determines the final equivalent average and admission possibility.

OtherArabOrForeignEquivalency.percentageRule: If the equivalency contains a percentage, AAUP uses it as stated; otherwise the applicable conversion method is used.
OtherArabOrForeignEquivalency.branchRule: If the equivalency states a branch, it is used. If it does not, scientific classification follows Palestinian Ministry equivalency rules.
OtherArabOrForeignEquivalency.studyLocationEvidence: Applicants may need proof that the required secondary-school years were studied in the country issuing the equivalency.
OtherArabOrForeignEquivalency.decisionMode: Case-by-case review by the Deanship of Admission and Registration.

importantCautions: A converted foreign-certificate percentage is not a guaranteed admission result.
The official website does not publish a separate program minimum for IB, British-system, SAT, AP, CLEP, or Saudi applicants; those fields remain null in the program records.
Some programs require interviews, theoretical tests, practical tests, health-sciences ability testing, fitness testing, or medical fitness documentation.
Admission availability and fees can change; the dataset records the Fall 2026/2027 status verified on 2026-07-23.
